digest_title: Daily Security Digest: Protocol, Parser, and Control-Plane Defenses
dek: Review new advisories across software supply chains, network proxies, test tools, sandboxes, and parsers, focusing on runtime verification and boundary enforcement.
overview: Defenders face multiple high-severity issues in upstream registries, proxy protocols, test tools, sandboxes, and parsers. Effective remediation requires verified running software versions, authenticated trust paths, and strict control-plane and boundary separation across diverse enterprise environments.

stories.headline: Socket Firewall TLS Verification
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90651 makes outbound TLS verification and private-CA handling part of package firewall assurance.
stories.why_it_matters: Unverified outbound connections risk code integrity and policy decisions.

stories.headline: HAProxy HTTP Request Smuggling
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90678 makes HAProxy remediation a protocol-path task: verify QUIC listeners, HTTP/1.1 backends and connection reuse together.
stories.why_it_matters: Protocol boundary translation flaws can bypass rules and corrupt request contexts.

stories.headline: ASE2000 Certificate Validation
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90647 makes ASE2000 remediation an inventory and trust-path task for teams testing IEC 60870-5-104 communications.
stories.why_it_matters: Portable industrial test tools create hidden trust paths and asset discovery challenges.

stories.headline: wasm2c Sandbox Allocation Flaw
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90648 shows why wasm2c deployments need embedded-runtime inventory, fail-closed allocation handling and an outer isolation boundary.
stories.why_it_matters: Allocation failures can cause memory mismatches and sandbox escapes.

stories.headline: UnrealIRCd Webserver Denial of Service
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90668 shows why UnrealIRCd operators must verify listeners, apply the 6.2.7 fix and test service resilience under pressure.
stories.why_it_matters: Optional enabled listeners create conditional exposure to memory exhaustion.

stories.headline: Strapi Rich-Text Preview Vulnerability
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90561 makes Strapi rich-text preview a role-boundary issue requiring a v5 upgrade, v4 migration and focused validation.
stories.why_it_matters: Preview renderers can bridge low-privileged content production into privileged sessions.

stories.headline: Spug Monitoring Command Injection
stories.summary: A new Spug command-injection CVE makes control-plane isolation, least privilege and runtime proof immediate defensive priorities.
stories.why_it_matters: Health-check features can allow ordinary roles to cross into control-plane execution.

stories.headline: sngrep SIP Packet Parsing Flaw
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90558 turns sngrep capture paths into a security boundary, requiring input scoping, least privilege and release-level patch proof.
stories.why_it_matters: Diagnostic packet analysis tools consume untrusted adversary input directly.

stories.headline: Nodemailer Address Parser Flaw
stories.summary: Nodemailer fixed a high-severity parsing denial of service; defenders should trace inbound email paths and prove patched code is running.
stories.why_it_matters: Algorithmic parsing complexity can stall single-threaded event loops.

stories.headline: CAPEv2 Task API Authorization Gap
stories.summary: CVE-2026-90768 exposes a cross-user authorization gap in CAPEv2 task APIs, making access scope and task ownership immediate review priorities.
stories.why_it_matters: Shared sandboxes must strictly enforce object-level ownership for case data.

operating_view: Verify running artifacts and effective configurations rather than relying on package manifests or version strings alone. Confirm that control-plane boundaries, trust chains, and resource limits remain intact across every deployment path and shared environment.
watch_items: Verify running binary versions and effective configurations across all target instances.
Enforce strict object ownership and protocol validation on unverified ingestion paths.
Maintain isolated outer boundaries for sandboxes and management control planes.
